chosen.description: The chosen option label, or null when abstained.

confidence.description: EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED: the probability mass on the reported answer (DEC-08).

calibrated.description: The upstream model ships uncalibrated logits with a clamping warning; this is never a calibrated probability (DEC-08).

answer_confidence.description: The same mass as confidence, named for parity with the vendored runtime's fields.

abstained.description: True when the model's act gate declined and allow_abstain permitted it.

action.description: The model's act-gate output, when the runtime reported one.
